rows: “I'm **currently in my third year** at university...”
speaking.caption: Bu Part 1 ning birinchi savoli — birinchi taassurot ✨ demanding, rewarding = Band 7 so‘zlar. Siz nima o‘qiysiz yoki ishlaysiz? Inglizcha yozing 👇

speaking.title: Shahringiz haqida
speaking.subtitle: “Tashkent is big and beautiful.” Zaif
rows: “...with a mix of **Soviet-style** buildings and modern **skyscrapers**.”
“**What I like most** is the food.”
speaking.caption:
Formula: joyni tasvirlash + shaxsiy fikr 🏙

O‘z shahringiz uchun shunday javob tayyorlang.

Siz qayerdansiz? 👇

speaking.title: Odamni tasvirlash
speaking.subtitle: Faqat tashqi ko‘rinish yetmaydi
speaking.caption:
“Describe a person who inspired you” — eng ko‘p chiqadigan kartalardan biri 🌟

Bitta odamni oldindan tayyorlab qo‘ying.

Sizni kim ilhomlantiradi? 👇

speaking.title: Joyni tasvirlash
speaking.subtitle: “It was beautiful.” Qanday go‘zal?
rows: “The streets were filled with **the smell of freshly baked bread**.”
speaking.caption:
5 sezgi usuli = examiner joyni ko‘z oldiga keltiradi 🖼

Bu Lexical Resource ni darrov ko‘taradi.

Sevimli joyingizni bitta gapda tasvirlang 👇

speaking.title: Narsani tasvirlash
speaking.subtitle: 40 soniyada gap tugadi
speaking.caption:
Har biriga 30 soniya = 2 daqiqa ⏱

“Something you own that is important to you” uchun bitta narsa tayyorlang.

Sizda qanday qimmatli narsa bor? 👇

speaking.title: Voqeani jonlantiring
speaking.subtitle: Detallar va dialog qo‘shing
speaking.caption:
Dialog hikoyani filmdek jonlantiradi 🎬

“Describe a time when you helped someone” uchun sinab ko‘ring.

Siz kimgadir yordam berganmisiz? 👇

speaking.title: Oxirgi nuqtani unutmang
speaking.subtitle: “...and explain why” — eng muhim qism
rows: **Explain why** eng ko‘p gapirish imkonini beradi
speaking.caption:
“Explain why” = his-tuyg‘u va fikr = eng ko‘p ball 🎯

Uni oxirga qoldirmang, vaqt yetmay qolishi mumkin.

Siz oxirgi nuqtaga yetib borasizmi? 👇

speaking.title: Examiner to‘xtatdi?
speaking.subtitle: Bu yaxshi belgi!
speaking.caption:
Xotirjam qoling va keyingi savolga tayyorlaning 😌

To‘xtatilish — muvaffaqiyat belgisi.

Buni bilarmidingiz? 👇

speaking.title: Asabiylashish
speaking.subtitle: Qo‘llar titrayapti, so‘zlar chiqmayapti
speaking.caption:
Hayajon tabiiy, uni boshqarish mumkin 🧘

Birinchi 2 daqiqa o‘tsa, odatda tinchlanasiz.

Siz imtihonda hayajonlanasizmi? 👇

speaking.title: “What about you?”
speaking.subtitle: Examinerga shaxsiy savol bermang
speaking.caption:
Examiner javob bermaydi va bu noqulay vaziyat yaratadi 😶

Diqqat sizning javobingizda bo‘lsin.

Buni bilarmidingiz? 👇

speaking.title: Fikrni o‘zgartirsa bo‘ladi
speaking.subtitle: Boshlagan fikr noto‘g‘ri chiqdimi?
speaking.caption:
Fikrni o‘zgartirish Fluency ga zarar bermaydi 🔄

Native speakerlar ham shunday qiladi.

Saqlab qo‘ying 🔖

speaking.title: “It depends” + jimlik
speaking.subtitle: Bu javob emas, boshlanish
speaking.caption:
“It depends” dan keyin har doim misollar keltiring 📋

Bu Part 3 uchun ideal tuzilma.

Siz “it depends” ni ko‘p ishlatasizmi? 👇

speaking.title: Kelajak haqida taxmin
speaking.subtitle: “How will education change?”
speaking.caption:
Part 3 da bunday savollar juda ko‘p 🚀

Shu iboralarni bilsangiz, qiyin savol ham oson.

Ta‘lim qanday o‘zgaradi deb o‘ylaysiz? Inglizcha yozing 👇

speaking.title: O‘tmish vs hozir
speaking.subtitle: “How has shopping changed?”
rows: “**In the past**, people **used to** shop at bazaars.”
“**These days, however**, more people order online.”
speaking.caption:
O‘zgarish haqidagi savollar Part 3 ning klassikasi 🔄

Shu formulani istalgan mavzuga moslang.

Sizning shahringizda nima o‘zgardi? 👇

speaking.title: “Yes, I agree.” yetmaydi
speaking.subtitle: Rozilikning darajalari bor
rows: “**I see their point**, but...” = muloyim norozilik
speaking.caption:
Darajani ko‘rsatish = nozik fikrlash = yuqori ball 🎓

So‘ng, albatta, sabab keltiring.

Siz qaysi birini ishlatasiz? 👇

speaking.title: Savolni takrorlamang
speaking.subtitle: “Do you like music?” — “Yes, I like music.”
rows: “**Absolutely**, I'm a **big fan**, especially of jazz.”
“I **can't live without it**, to be honest.”
speaking.caption:
Sinonim = Lexical Resource ko‘rsatish imkoniyati 🎯

Savolni eshitib, uni boshqa so‘zlar bilan javobga aylantiring.

Siz musiqani yaxshi ko‘rasizmi? Inglizcha javob bering 👇

speaking.title: Ishonchli boshlang
speaking.subtitle: Har javob “Emm... yes...” bilan
speaking.caption:
Birinchi so‘z ishonch beradi va keyingi gaplar oson keladi 🚀

Shu 4 ta boshlanishni yodlang, ular har qanday savolga mos.

Qaysi biri sizga yoqdi? 👇

speaking.title: O‘qish ≠ gapirish
speaking.subtitle: Mavzularni o‘qiysiz, lekin ovoz chiqarmaysiz
rows: Part 2 kartasi: **1 daqiqa reja, 2 daqiqa nutq**
speaking.caption:
Telefonga yozib oling va qayta tinglang 🔁

Gapirish faqat gapirish orqali rivojlanadi.

Bugun 10 daqiqa gapirasizmi? 👇

speaking.title: O‘zingizni eshiting
speaking.subtitle: Xatolaringizni bilmaysiz
speaking.caption:
Birinchi marta o‘z ovozingizni eshitish g‘alati, lekin juda foydali 😅

2-urinish har doim yaxshiroq chiqadi.

Sinab ko‘rganmisiz? 👇

speaking.title: Sherik bilan mashq
speaking.subtitle: Yolg‘iz tayyorlanish jonli suhbatga o‘rgatmaydi
speaking.caption:
Speaking sherigi = eng yaxshi bepul o‘qituvchi 🤝

Izohda sherik qidirayotganlar bir-birini topsin 👇

Kim sherik qidiryapti?

speaking.title: Part 1 mavzulari
speaking.subtitle: Ular takrorlanadi, tayyorlaning
speaking.caption:
Har biri uchun 10 ta so‘z va 1 ta shaxsiy hikoya tayyorlang 📒

Part 1 = oson ball, agar tayyor bo‘lsangiz.

Qaysi mavzu sizga eng qiyin? 👇

speaking.title: Universal hikoyalar
speaking.subtitle: Har karta uchun yangi hikoya kerak emas
speaking.caption:
Bitta sayohat hikoyasi “a place”, “a happy memory”, “a journey” kartalariga mos 🔁

5–6 ta hikoya = 50+ kartaga tayyor.

Sizning universal hikoyangiz qaysi? 👇

speaking.title: Furthermore — yozma til
speaking.subtitle: Speaking da tabiiy gapiring
speaking.caption:
Speaking — suhbat, insho emas 🗣

Yozma iboralar og‘zaki nutqda sun‘iy eshitiladi.

Siz Speaking da “moreover” ishlatganmisiz? 😅

speaking.title: I do not know → I don't
speaking.subtitle: Qisqartmasiz nutq = robot
rows: “I do not know. I am not sure. It is good.”
speaking.caption:
Writing da qisqartma yo‘q, Speaking da esa — albatta ✅

Bu nutqni ravon va tabiiy qiladi.

Buni bilarmidingiz? 👇

speaking.title: Tayyor bo‘laklar
speaking.subtitle: Har gapni so‘zma-so‘z tuzish sekin
speaking.caption:
Bunday bo‘laklar miyaga vaqt beradi va nutqni tezlashtiradi ⚡

Kuniga 2 ta yangi bo‘lak o‘rganing va ishlating.

Siz qaysi bo‘lakni ko‘p ishlatasiz? 👇

speaking.title: Qiziqishni ko‘rsating
speaking.subtitle: Sevimli hobbi haqida zerikkan ohang
speaking.caption:
Examiner muloqot qobiliyatini ham his qiladi 🎭

Yoqtirgan narsangiz haqida gapirganda bu tabiiy chiqadi.

Siz nimani gapirganda ko‘zingiz yonadi? 👇

speaking.title: Ko‘z bilan aloqa
speaking.subtitle: Stolga qarab gapirish
speaking.caption:
Ishonchli ko‘rinish ishonchli gapirishga yordam beradi 💪

Mashq paytida ham sherigingizga qarab gapiring.

Siz ko‘z kontaktida qiynalasizmi? 👇

speaking.title: Isinib oling
speaking.subtitle: Ertalabdan jim = birinchi javoblar qiyin
speaking.caption:
Til mushaklari ham isinishni talab qiladi 🏃

Sportchi isinmasdan maydonga chiqmaydi, siz ham.

Siz imtihondan oldin nima qilasiz? 👇

speaking.title: 4 baholash mezoni
speaking.subtitle: Qanday baholanishini biling
speaking.caption:
Har biri 25% ⚖️

O‘zingizni yozib, har mezon bo‘yicha 1–9 baho bering.

Qaysi mezonda eng kuchlisiz? 👇

speaking.title: Fluency = tezlik emas
speaking.subtitle: Ravonlik — uzluksiz va mantiqiy nutq
speaking.caption:
Mantiqiy oqim tezlikdan muhimroq 🧠

Bog‘lovchi iboralar nutqni tartibli qiladi.

Siz fikrlaringizni qanday bog‘laysiz? 👇

speaking.title: Mavzuni bilmaysizmi?
speaking.subtitle: “Describe a piece of art.” San‘atga qiziqmaysiz
speaking.caption:
Har qanday kartani o‘z hayotingizga bog‘lash mumkin 🔗

Kreativlik — Speaking ning yashirin quroli.

Eng qiyin kartangiz qaysi edi? 👇

speaking.title: Aniq yakunlang
speaking.subtitle: Gap to‘satdan tugaydi, examiner kutadi
rows: “**So yeah**, that's why I love it.”
“**So, all in all**, it was a great experience.”
speaking.caption:
Aniq yakun examinerga tugaganingizni bildiradi ✅

Noqulay jimlik o‘rniga — chiroyli nuqta.

Saqlab qo‘ying 🔖

speaking.title: Speaking ni kechiktirmang
speaking.subtitle: Eng sekin rivojlanadigan ko‘nikma
speaking.caption:
Kunlik odat haftalik marafondan samaraliroq 🔥

Bugundan boshlang: 15 daqiqa, istalgan mavzu.

Imtihoningizgacha necha hafta qoldi? 👇

speaking.title: Inglizcha o‘ylang
speaking.subtitle: Tarjima qilish nutqni sekinlashtiradi
rows: “I'm waiting for the bus. **It's late again**.”
speaking.caption:
Kuniga 5 daqiqa = 3 haftada tarjima odati kamayadi 🧠

Bu eng oddiy, lekin eng kuchli mashq.

Hozir atrofingizni bitta inglizcha gap bilan tasvirlang 👇
